overall: The Council violated the Open Meeting Law by giving insufficient notice and announcement of its litigation executive session, and by discussing off-topic matters in it; no violation on the minutes-receipt allegation.

allegations.summary: Notice for the June 11 meeting listed only 'Litigation update' and did not identify the litigation matters to be discussed in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: As in OML 2024-139, we find here that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to identify in the notice for its June 11 meeting the litigation matters to be discussed in executive session.

allegations.summary: The open-session announcement before convening in executive session was alleged to be insufficient because it did not identify the litigation matters.
allegations.key_passage: Relatedly, we find that the announcement prior to convening in executive session on June 11 violated the Open Meeting Law where it failed to identify the litigation matters to be discussed and did not include a declaration that holding the discussion in open session may have a detrimental effect on the Council's litigating position.

allegations.summary: The June 11 executive session was alleged to be for an improper purpose; the litigation topics qualified, but non-litigation matters were discussed.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law when it discussed matters in executive session on June 11 that were not appropriate for executive session and were not included on the notice for the June 11 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged council members had not received executive session minutes for over five years; the AG found no requirement that members receive them.
allegations.key_passage: we find no violation with respect to the allegation that the Council has not received executive session minutes.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Announce at the next open session meeting the specific litigation matters, or types of matters, discussed in executive session on June 11.
Release the minutes of the June 11 executive session to the public within 30 days of the date of the letter, with redactions limited as described.
remedy_passage: we order the Council to release the minutes of the June 11 executive session to the public within 30 days of the date of this letter.
